faq.a: Abdulkhaliq represents Arabic عَبْدُ الْخَالِق, meaning servant of the Creator.

faq.q: What is the origin of Abdulkhaliq?
faq.a: The name is Arabic and is a compound of عبد and a second element.
Yes. The underlying compound is عَبْدُ الْخَالِق (ʿAbd al-Khāliq).

faq.q: What is the root of Abdulkhaliq?
faq.a: عبد is related to ع ب د; al-Khāliq is related to خ ل ق (kh-l-q).
Abdulkhaliq is a traditional Muslim personal name because it contains a compound invoking al-Khāliq, a divine epithet in Islamic tradition.
This record does not establish Abdulkhaliq as an explicitly named Qur'anic person; the compound's religious meaning is distinct from personal-name attestation in the text.

faq.q: What does Abdulkhaliq mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, the name means servant of the Creator; the compound combines عبد with al-Khāliq.
The supplied “ab-dul-kha-liq” is an approximate pronunciation; local pronunciations vary.

faq.q: Is Abdulkhaliq a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: The record classifies the name as masculine, consistent with traditional usage; regional frequency data is not supplied.
